items.text: Rams TE Tyler Higbee ruled out with chest injury mid-game vs Packers; Davis Allen also already ruled out, leaving thin TE depth.
items.why: Chest injury sustained in game; Schefter confirmation after prior Allen out.
items.implication: Rams TE usage collapses; Parkinson or others elevated if available.
items.opportunity: Elevated TE opportunity and red-zone looks for remaining LAR pass-catchers short-term.

items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson ruled out with concussion after sideline hit evaluation during Wed night vs Rams; previously returned from thigh but later OUT.
items.why: Concussion evaluation post-hit by ejected Rams S Kinchens; confirmed ruled out by Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Remove from lineups; GB WR targets redistribute short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining Packers WRs in remaining game time and ROS if multi-week.

items.text: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III ruled OUT (groin) for TNF vs Bills; third straight miss after limited practices then DNP Wednesday.
items.why: Groin strain management; team cautious with soft-tissue history and Emmett Johnson production.
items.implication: Full backfield to Johnson/handcuffs; Walker managers pivot immediately for TNF.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries/snaps/routes for KC RB depth; high volume vs BUF.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy DNP Wednesday with ankle injury from SNF vs Vikings; day-to-day, Shanahan notes he finished the prior game.
items.why: Ankle suffered Week 11 Q2 but finished game; first DNP.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday practice for Week 12 vs SEA; backup contingency.
items.opportunity: If out, elevated rush/pass share for CMC and SF skill players under backup.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving this week vs CAR: since Week 5 only Gibbs/CMC average more FPPG among RBs; elite matchup.
items.why: Elite recent FPPG + CAR defense allows high RB fantasy points.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; smash spot for volume and efficiency.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target share expected in favorable run matchup.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs OUT (finger) for Wednesday night vs Rams per injury reports.
items.why: Finger injury; listed OUT on final reports for TNF-eve game.
items.implication: GB RB committee elevates; limited floor without Jacobs.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for Lloyd/backups; watch snap share.

items.text: Berry notes Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% (4.5 rec/g) with Brissett vs prior <6%; significantly raises PPR floor.
items.why: Two games with Brissett show clear receiving involvement increase.
items.implication: Safer PPR RB2 with dual-threat floor; LOVE in that context.

items.text: ETR Week 12 preview: Puka Nacua and Terrance Ferguson season-ending; Colts cut Jones with AR starting; Tuten injury resurfaces.
items.why: Season-ending injuries confirmed in ETR team-by-team; Tuten ankle/foot aggravation.
items.implication: LAR WR depth shifts permanently; JAX RB monitor practice for TEN.
items.opportunity: LAR targets to Adams/others; JAX backup carries if Tuten limited/out.

items.text: Cowboys TE Jake Ferguson OUT (knee/ankle) for third straight game vs Eagles on Thanksgiving; no practice this week.
items.why: MCL/PCL sprains; multi-week absence confirmed, no practice participation.
items.implication: Spann-Ford leads TE; low fantasy upside but TD-or-bust streamer.
items.opportunity: Slight target bump for DAL WRs/RBs in two-TE sets or red zone.

items.text: Berry HATES Bo Nix this week: expects heavy Jonah Coleman run game vs PIT; insufficient rushing from Nix; ranks outside top 20 QBs.
items.why: Game script leans run-heavy with Coleman; Nix rush upside limited vs PIT.

items.text: Levitan on Etienne: expects disappointing snaps/routes down stretch but reasonably high carry count; favorable ARZ/ATL Weeks 16-17 schedule. Cites Graziano reporting.
items.why: Snaps/routes caution from coaching/scheme; carry floor and playoff matchups support value.
items.implication: RB2/flex with volume floor but limited upside if routes stay low; roster for ROS.
items.opportunity: Carry share and goal-line work remain; monitor snap trends weekly.
items.conflict: Usage (snaps/routes) weaker than pure carry projection implies.

items.text: Berry: Ladd McConkey season-high 38% target share in return (20.7 FP); when >=20% share averages 17.5 PPG; health key.
items.why: Strong target share on limited snaps post-return.
items.implication: Solid WR2/3 if healthy; monitor snap % continuity.
items.opportunity: High route/target share when active >50% snaps.

items.text: Berry: Trey McBride 39% target share (19 targets) last 2 weeks under Beck/Johnson but aDOT only 3 yards, 6.5 YPR, 11.8 PPG; volume TE1 but not elite.
items.why: High volume persists but efficiency tanks with short aDOT post-Brissett.
items.implication: Safe TE1 floor via targets; lower ceiling without deep/red-zone pops.
items.opportunity: Sustained target share in ARI offense.

items.text: Berry downgrades D'Andre Swift (47% snaps, 39% rushes with Monangai back) and Jaylen Warren (51% rush share, low targets post-Dowdle) to mid/low RB2.
items.why: Teammate returns compressing snaps/carries/targets; utilization drops.
items.opportunity: Reduced; monitor if roles expand again.
